title: Text: DET Al Avila ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: I have a (positive) story to write for Sunday on and I wanted to see if I can get some background info. I will tell you what my angle is and what I’m looking for. I know you have not spoken to media so no quotes
Just saw your call, missed it earlier. Thank you. Maybe try on way home or tomorrow. Won’t take long
